headlines.description: Leodis McKelvin scored on a 79-yard punt return, and the Buffalo Bills' defense finally flexed its muscles in a 19-14 victory over the Miami Dolphins on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McKelvin's punt return for TD, 4 FGs lift Bills

headlines.description: Matt Ryan overcame a career-worst five interceptions, guiding Atlanta to its only offensive touchdown in the fourth quarter, and the Falcons rallied for a sloppy 23-19 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons rally past Cards despite Ryan's 5 INTs

headlines.description: Dan Bailey kicked a 38-yard field goal in overtime, and Dallas overcame a critical fumble by Tony Romo that sparked a wild ending in the Cowboys' 23-20 victory against Cleveland on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bailey's FG seals Cowboys' wild win vs. Browns

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw two touchdown passes, including a 22-yarder to Randall Cobb with 1:55 left, and the Green Bay Packers came through with a 24-20 win over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers rescues Packers with late TD to Cobb

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw for 230 yards and accounted for three touchdowns, A.J. Green caught a touchdown passin his ninth straight game and the Cincinnati Bengals beat the woeful Kansas City Chiefs 28-6 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals blow out Chiefs to get back to .500

events.name: New York Jets at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Mark Sanchez directed a turnover-free offense and Bilal Powell ran for the first two touchdowns of his career, helping the New York Jets end a three-game losing streak with a 27-13 victory over the St. Louis Rams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Solid Sanchez helps Jets end three-game skid

headlines.description: Robert Griffin III threw four touchdown passes Sunday, and the Washington Redskins broke a three-game losing streak with a 31-6 win over the skidding Philadelphia Eagles.
headlines.shortLinkText: RG3 throws 4 TDs in Redskins' rout of Eagles

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Josh Freeman threw a 15-yard touchdown pass to Dallas Clark in overtime to cap the Tampa Bay Buccaneers' 27-21 comeback win over the Carolina Panthers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeman, Bucs rally late, stun Panthers in OT

headlines.description: Andre Johnson caught a screen pass from Matt Schaub and ran 48 yards for the winning touchdown in overtime as the Houston Texans rallied to beat Jacksonville 43-37 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans outlast Jags, win 43-37 OT thriller

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw three touchdown passes and Malcolm Jenkins returned an interception for a score to get the New Orleans Saints back to .500 with a 38-17 victory over the Oakland Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints back at .500 thanks to rout of Raiders

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Peyton Manning threw for three touchdowns and Von Miller had three sacks, as the Denver Broncos defeated the San Diego Chargers 30-23 on Sunday to take a three-game lead in the AFC West.

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for three touchdowns, Andrew Luck misfired on two interceptions returned for touchdowns and the New England Patriots tied their single-game scoring record with a 59-24 rout of the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady outshines Luck as Patriots score 59

headlines.description: Jacoby Jones returned a punt for a touchdown, Justin Tucker kicked two field goals, and the Baltimore Ravens took control of the AFC North with a 13-10 victory over the Pittsburgh Steelers on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones' punt return helps lift Ravens

headlines.description: Colin Kaepernick passed for 243 yards and two touchdowns in his first career start in place of the injured Alex Smith, and the San Francisco 49ers whipped the Chicago Bears 32-7 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaepernick shines as Niners trounce Bears
